purpose: Separate 200-URL replication recipe using the recorded measurement definitions. This recipe contains no observations. Retain the existing two-batch dataset and write new measurements to a distinct output directory.
order: fixed-seed Fisher-Yates shuffle; each URL completed sequentially; no concurrent page collection

browser.cache_state: fresh isolated Playwright context per run; service workers blocked
browser.actions: two trusted wheel commands only; no form filling, button clicking, login, consent acceptance, overlay removal, or access-control bypass
browser.timing: Node monotonic clock around mouse.wheel. Command completion is not scroll completion, INP, paint time, or user task success. Viewport displacement is diagnostic only.
browser.requests: Count requests started from navigation through the end of the second fixed post-action wait. Successful requests must have finished with HTTP 200-399 and no failure. Pending requests remain in the denominator and are reported separately.

lighthouse.skip_condition: skip and record null metrics if all five browser runs are ineligible

eligibility: At least three browser runs with valid HTTP content and two successful wheel commands; finite nonnegative LCP and CLS; finite audit score 0-100; finite pooled command duration and request-success percentage. Failures and challenges are excluded with reasons, not replaced by perfect scores.
failed_measurements: Preserve all attempts and exceptions; unavailable endpoints are null. HTTP errors and observed access/authentication challenges are recorded without bypass.
retry_policy: No replacement URL and no success-targeted rerun. Five prescribed attempts per URL; worker failure remains an unavailable measurement.

analysis.interpretation: Descriptive statistics on eligible recorded URLs. Bootstrap is conditional on the single Lighthouse audit and resamples browser run records. Weights are explicit preferences, not user-derived estimates.

stopping_rule: Process all 200 specified URLs in seeded order, five browser attempts per URL and one conditional audit. Retain failures; no replacement or success-targeted reruns.
limitations: One machine, browser, viewport and session; purposive URLs; one Lighthouse audit per eligible URL; scroll-only command endpoint; no semantic task-completion or human data; no estimate of historical website changes.
